animationPlan.motivation: Teacher identity comes from teaching action and a populated room.
animationPlan.anticipation: teacher and students orient head and weight toward the acting object before contact.
animationPlan.contact: chalk touches the board as students face forward; hands and any held prop share the same rig socket.
animationPlan.weightShift: Standing actors shift over the supporting foot; seated actors remain anchored through hips and chair.
animationPlan.actionPeak: chalk touches the board as students face forward
animationPlan.followThrough: The action settles with a readable hold before cut to sewing close-up.
animationPlan.secondaryMotion: classroom uses offset breathing, tool response or environmental motion without synchronized looping.

issues: Checked hand contact, text collisions, floor contact and unsupported factual additions.
fixes: Aligned held props to wrists, corrected baselines and separated text bands where required.
